coverageContext: Complete 654-term UK Biobank penalized-regression model for coded disorders of iron metabolism. Covariate-adjusted partial correlations were about 0.131 in the UK group and 0.109 in the Polish group; the Italian and non-European intervals included zero. This is a broad coded endpoint, not a serum iron or ferritin measurement, a diagnosis of iron deficiency or hereditary hemochromatosis, an HFE diplotype test, or a basis for iron supplements or phlebotomy. GA preserves the genetic sum without reproducing clinical covariates or calculating disease probability.
